title: {GroomName} & {BrideName} — Wedding Invitation
shareMessage: You are invited to the wedding of {GroomName} & {BrideName}.

opening.bismillahTranslation: In the Name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful
opening.lead: With the blessings of Allah ﷻ and our beloved parents,
opening.invite: we cordially invite you to grace the joyous wedding celebration of
opening.closing: as they begin their blessed journey together in marriage.
opening.verseArabic: وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ أَنْ خَلَقَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا لِّتَسْكُنُوا إِلَيْهَا وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَكُم مَّوَدَّةً وَرَحْمَةً
opening.verseEnglish: “And He has placed between you mutual affection and boundless mercy.”

items.line: Joyfully invite you to celebrate the marriage of their beloved son
items.name: {GroomName}

items.line: Joyfully invite you to celebrate the marriage of their beloved daughter
items.name: {BrideName}

celebration.heading: A Day of Joy & Barakah
celebration.sub: In Shaa Allah, join us in making this auspicious occasion truly memorable.

calendar.title: Nikah of {GroomName} & {BrideName}
calendar.details: Nikah ceremony followed by the wedding reception at KMS Convention Centre.
calendar.location: KMS Convention Centre, Kambalapadavu, Konaje, Next to Bharath Petrol, Pajeeru Guttu, Karnataka 574153

closing.heading: May Allah bless their marriage with everlasting love, mercy & barakah.
closing.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكُمَا وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكُمَا وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
closing.translation: “May Allah bless you both, shower His divine blessings upon you, and unite you both in goodness.”

footer: With warmest gratitude from the families of {Bride's Mom} & {Bride's Dad} and {Groom's Dad} & {Groom's Mom} · {Year}
